sample_unit: patients (brain CT cases read by 9 reviewers with and without AI)
models_evaluated: deep learning AIH detection algorithm (trained on 104,666 slices from 3010 patients)

links.outcome: Diagnostic accuracy of reviewers with versus without AI assistance for intracranial haemorrhage on CT
links.effect: Patient-wise accuracy 0.9703 with AI vs 0.9471 without (p<0.0001); largest gain in non-radiologist physicians; neuroradiologists' gain not significant.
links.quote: Brain CT interpretation with AI assistance results in significantly higher diagnostic accuracy than that without AI assistance (0.9703 vs. 0.9471, p < 0.0001, patient-wise).

screen.reason: The study tests the clinical deployment practice of AI assistance compared to unassisted reading across multiple types of clinicians in a multi-reader crossover study.
